messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Profile | Corporate Affairs, ESG & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Saudi German Health Recruitment Team,

I am sharing my executive profile for senior corporate opportunities in Saudi Arabia spanning corporate and external affairs, government relations, ESG and sustainability, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive operations.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, executive communications and cross-functional execution within a major multinational operation.

My strongest fit is with Director, Senior Director and Head-level mandates where institutional relationships, governance, reputation, responsible business and coordinated delivery across functions support organizational growth.

My Saudi/GCC executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile, available with 30 days notice and open to employer-supported relocation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc. (Zijin Mining Group)
